name: Glean
tagline: Enterprise AI work assistant grounded in your company's data
description: Glean is an AI-powered enterprise search and work assistant that connects to 100+ workplace apps (Google Workspace, Slack, Confluence, Salesforce, Jira, GitHub) and lets employees ask questions grounded in their own company data. Glean Assistant adds a Claude/GPT-powered chat that respects per-user permissions and provides citations to source documents.
pricingDetails: Enterprise only — custom pricing, typically per-seat for orgs of 100+ employees.
